{{Top|leg}}
An '''autowrench''' was a hand-tool employed in the tightening and loosening of common fasteners, such as nuts and bolts. It was placed on the fastener, the wrench would then automatically spin in the desired direction. It was a rather large tool, and could not be used in all applications.
